answer.rationale: Primary contract ends in 14 days with no auto-renew, so defer or add-second-source leave the line uncovered; incumbent already refused a price reopen, so renew/negotiate miss the mandated 18% cut. The low-cost quote is the only path that both secures supply and hits the cost target. Intent depends on whether last year's low-cost cutover (c2) really was fast and clean versus the stability of staying put (c1)—those two records are the load-bearing ones to verify. 94% utilization with no buffer means any primary cutover can starve assembly; treat as a contained cutover, not a silent broad rollout, until those sources check out.
